The final answer of 39 is incorrect.

The expression simplifies correctly in the proposed solution to s⁴ + m⁴ + t⁴ − 2(s²m² + s²t² + m²t²), which equals P² − 4Q with P = 8 and Q = s²m² + s²t² + m²t².

From P² = (s⁴ + m⁴ + t⁴) + 2Q we get 64 = 25 + 2Q, so 2Q = 39 and Q = 19.5.

The value is then 64 − 4(19.5) = 64 − 78 = −14. Equivalently, 25 − 2Q = 25 − 39 = −14.

The solution stops at 2Q = 39 (it also degenerates into endless repetition) and 39 is reported as the answer, but that is only 2Q, not the requested product. The correct value is −14.

VERDICT: REJECT
